title: Practice: Past progressive: I was writing

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **говорить → говорила** — past tense, fem.: drop -ть, add -ла.
exercises.prompt: She was talking all the time.
The couple was walking arm in arm.

exercises.why: **смотреть → смотрел** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.
exercises.prompt: Daniel was looking out the window.

exercises.why: **жить → жил** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.
exercises.prompt: He was living with his aunt.

exercises.why: **сидеть → сидел** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.
exercises.prompt: Tom was sitting below an apple tree.

exercises.why: **стоять → стоял** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.
**продолжать → продолжала** — past tense, fem.: drop -ть, add -ла.
exercises.prompt: This pair of lovers were carrying on an ardent correspondence.

exercises.q: Мальчик ___ (глядеть) на стаю карпов в пруду.
exercises.why: **глядеть → глядел** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.
exercises.prompt: The boy was gazing at a school of carp in the pond.

exercises.why: **чувствовать → чувствовал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.
exercises.prompt: I felt I was being spied on.

exercises.why: **лежать → лежали** — past tense, plural: drop -ть, add -ли.
exercises.prompt: They were lying on the grass.

exercises.why: **ходить → ходил** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.
exercises.prompt: He was walking up and down the station platform.

exercises.why: **слушать → слушали** — past tense, plural: drop -ть, add -ли.
exercises.prompt: They were not listening to music.
